# Mobile Infrastructure Announces Timing of Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call


October 13, 2026 4:05 PM EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_f5a62e3f95e2b908c8e4881221df8105/mobileit/news/2026-10-13_Mobile_Infrastructure_Announces_Timing_of_Third_53.pdf)


CINCINNATI, Oct. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Mobile Infrastructure Corporation (NASDAQ: BEEP), the nation’s only publicly traded owner of parking infrastructure, will issue its third quarter 2026 earnings release after the U.S. market closes on Tuesday, November 10, 2026.


You are invited to participate in the Company’s conference call hosted by senior management on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 4:30 PM Eastern Time.


**Q3 2026 Conference Call Date & Time:**
Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 4:30 PM Eastern Time


Participants who wish to access the live conference call may do so by registering[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=mY3j10YgIUkeJGnaC4HXU4QhWVJhaN0EYg4UspGuVrfzDrnf9SCRrZ5LSGeoCa5PIrVycmZFP15YZ7CiOKgzo6vAQy3s3klJVwA-FeNrkZi30-7BtXxrrCBo5md9GL6vsvschcM_iQb97aMIgNidUhp8RPiP9q4J8sMpl_ORaEI=) . Upon registration, a dial-in and unique PIN will be provided to join the call.


A live, listen-only webcast of the conference call may be accessed from the[Investor Relations](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=b_6DAP6KY3CngaLTKr3AHGR3VhtV93ZR-m8cAsO8u0jwZEIeYNc-5kpvqwM8EIbhElqK2jqrT8BckwqUY-YjY1pxoSJRZYBEv0kcbMudzjVATvfP5kgA2zCwuvWcJWe9p7ZqdRK5yOnRJyonlZHbRTCKJ0esC2IdZRIoef11plr1JW7A57Cp8w2SdVdCnRT9m4GFDjksNQyB4-T9alXHXutJlWdtWRhCW-cbbF8y-3jcIET4W5VAqc8SAw-5-Z7LEHjoBslDemle0wbzwJW9xQ==) section of the Company’s website, or by registering[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=mY3j10YgIUkeJGnaC4HXU_e7T7SOW4ejEwItf89Bhm2x9jqxARDa_eiKzYt3ePIkcXVH2zmZZaPPMAryi8umgZ5t_2NjhPOkqzr5U8pIA_c=) .


For those who are unable to listen to the live broadcast, a replay of the webcast will be available in the “News & Events” section of the Investor Relations website under “IR Calendar” for one year.


**About Mobile Infrastructure Corporation**


Mobile Infrastructure Corporation (NASDAQ: BEEP), headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, owns and operates a diversified portfolio of parking facilities across the United States. As of September 30, 2026, the Company owned 35 parking facilities in 18 separate markets with a total of approximately 13,200 parking spaces and approximately 4.6 million square feet. Mobile Infrastructure is focused on the future of urban mobility, repositioning parking assets as critical components of transportation infrastructure.
